change_record.when: required for every revision of an existing ProductSpec

requirement_mapping.requirement: 1-based position of the requirement in requirements
criteria: AC<position> of an acceptance criterion, at least one when the requirement can be verified
requirement_mapping.gap: reason when no acceptance criterion can be written; give either criteria or gap

product_spec.basis_product_spec_hash: content hash of the ProductSpec this revision is based on; null for the first spec; the host rejects the submission if it does not equal the current effective ProductSpec content_hash

notes: 不带 PRD 修订的回答不更新PRD；产品决定和需求正文经正常接纳后才生效。
控制层校验失败会返回字段级错误，下一轮按 validation_feedback 修正。

bind: run_check receipts from this activation on the current workspace
delivery_spec.basis_product_spec_hash: content hash of the ProductSpec this delivery is based on; the host rejects the submission if it does not equal the current effective ProductSpec content_hash

launch.what: one entry per entry point the delivered software needs a trial for; optional, leave it out for libraries and command line programs
launch.name: entry point name, unique within this DeliverySpec
launch.commands: argv per system; the keys are windows or linux, at least one
launch.ready_url: web apps only: an http URL on 127.0.0.1 or localhost containing {port}; desktop programs have none
launch.ready_timeout_sec: optional readiness timeout in seconds; the registered default when omitted

bind: run_check receipts from this activation bound to the current snapshot, one per build_and_test entry
workspace tree digest must equal the snapshot tree digest

notes: 直接 write_file、run_check，最后 submit_delivery；写入范围必须落在当前有效合同界定的目标与边界之内。
改变产品要求必须请产品正常接纳，不能在交付中新增要求。
check_names 必须对应本次激活中在当前工作区上调用 run_check 的回执；bash 的结果不能作为检查回执，模型自报的 exit_code 无效。

criteria.criterion: AC<position> of the acceptance criterion in the current ProductSpec (1-based)
criteria.method: check | trial | measure | judgement | human | open; check, trial and measure are executable, the others are open
criteria.checks: quality check names from this activation that support this criterion
criteria.trial_cases: leave it empty (trial cases arrive with a later ticket)

bind: quality host check receipts; engineering receipts are rejected
qa_review.basis_delivery_spec_hash: content hash of the DeliverySpec this review is based on; the host rejects the submission if it does not equal the current effective DeliverySpec content_hash

conclusions.evidence: a passing check name, a location, or the failing check name

omissions.capability: an outward-facing capability missing from the initial PRD

verdict_rules.consistent: no unsupported conclusion, no omission, and every check with a non-zero exit status is referenced by an existing_defect conclusion or explained in other_failures
verdict_rules.rework_product: at least one unsupported conclusion or one omission

bind: one conclusion per requirement of the current initial PRD, no more and no less
at least one run_check receipt from this activation bound to the current snapshot and the current ProductSpec
workspace tree digest must equal the snapshot tree digest

notes: criteria 覆盖当前 ProductSpec 的全部验收条件，每条一项：criterion 是 AC<序号>（验收条件在 ProductSpec 里的位置，从 1 开始），method 是检验方式，result 只有 passed、failed、unverified。
可执行检验（check、trial、measure）写成 passed 时要有证据：checks 里列出本次激活的质检 run_check 回执；trial_cases 现在必须为空。不可执行检验（judgement、human、open）的条件可以是 unverified，放行时列进开环明细。
release 要求缺陷为空、质量检查 exit_code 均为 0、没有 failed 的条目、可执行检验的条目都是 passed。
rework 至少包含一条缺陷。

product_decision.message: this product decision has already been accepted

delivery_spec.message: no run_check receipt named {name} in this activation for the current snapshot and effective contract. Call run_check with the name {name} on the current workspace, then submit_delivery again; bash results are action receipts and do not count as check receipts.

referenced.message: delivery is not bound to the current ProductSpec
delivery is not bound to the current effective contract

qa_review.message: workspace snapshot no longer matches the current delivery
quality must run {name} against the current snapshot, ProductSpec, and DeliverySpec in this activation; prior receipts are not reused
the department {department} authored the delivery it is evaluating; a department cannot evaluate its own artifact

missing.message: an onboarding proposal requires the code snapshot recorded when the run was created

structure.message: the workspace tree {actual} no longer matches the snapshot {recorded}
no run_check receipt named {name} in this activation bound to the current snapshot and ProductSpec; call run_check with this name, then submit_structure again

missing.message: the baseline review requires a structure description of the current ProductSpec

referenced.message: the baseline review requires a structure description of the current ProductSpec

missing.message: an onboarding proposal requires the code snapshot recorded when the run was created

baseline_review.message: the workspace tree {actual} no longer matches the snapshot {recorded}
quality must run {name} against the current snapshot and ProductSpec in this activation; prior receipts and engineering receipts are not reused
the department {department} authored the structure it is evaluating; a department cannot evaluate its own artifact
